tests.title: Settings opens on the workflow map: one h1 and the Pilot chip, no seven-tab bar, the toolbar, the locked guardrail drawn, the seeded workflows listed
More settings: People, Roles, Units, Family link, Audit and Presenter open their own page with a way back; ?tab=rules opens the map with the rule library
palette: When, If, Then, Always groups with a hover definition, the rule library with a verification icon, and the locked steps with the reason
drag: a block moves with the pointer and snaps to the 20 px grid, its lines follow, Save lights up, Undo puts it back; nothing is stored until Save
keyboard: Tab to a block, arrows move it by one grid step (Shift by five), Enter opens the editor, Delete removes it (Undo returns it); no drag needed
the locked guardrail cannot be selected, moved or removed; the palette lists it as always on
palette: a block is dragged onto the canvas and lands on the grid; Enter or a click adds one too (after the selected block, linked to its free exit)

link: drag from an exit dot to a block; a loop, a self link and a link into a When block are refused with a reason; click a line and Delete removes it; the inspector pickers do the same without dragging
rules: drop a rule from the library onto a block (or Add a rule in the inspector); the card shows a rules badge; detach removes it
inspector: typed settings from the catalog (number, select, roles, text); the card summary follows; a rule-bound number shows the live rule and its Edit asks why and changes the rule everywhere
Save calls workflow.save: version and history move on, Save goes quiet (Saved · v2); a workflow with a problem is refused and the problems are listed; Reload keeps the draft saved
the On / Off switch calls workflow.enable on the saved workflow; unsaved changes ask for a Save first; a workflow with errors cannot be turned on
Test run: runs the current (unsaved) workflow on the live demo data, says test only, shows counts and a table; a match lights its path; nothing is written
Outline: the same workflow as an indented list with kind, summary, edit and remove, and Add a block here; everything the map does works without dragging
390 px: the Outline is the default, the palette is an Add block picker, editing opens a drawer, no sideways scroll, targets 24 px or more, every control labelled
1024 px: the map, toolbar and editor fit without sideways scroll; the palette opens over the layout on request
the "second person" guardrail: a saved change waits (the live version does not change), Settings says so, a different person (the clinician, from the Dashboard) confirms, the proposer cannot
